subject: prd/review-feedback-capture
statement: The system shall expose, computable from the ledger alone, the review-rejection rate, human edit-distance, and disposition counts, per subject class.
fit_criterion: each of the three measures is computed from ledger contents with no external state, for at least one subject class (their precise definitions — rejection-rate denominator, edit-distance unit — pinned in the tech design, Q5)
